#Welcome to My BIOL 109 Tutorials This website contains tutorials on tasks from BIOL 109. Here you will find guides to help you with lab skills, presentations, and more.

##Tutorials -How to Maintain a Lab Notebook

— How to Maintain a Lab Notebook” description: “step-by-step guide for Biol 109 students” — ##Introduction Keeping a lab notebook helps track experiments, observations, and results accurately

Materials needed

-Notebook (spiral or bound) -Pen (blue or black ink) -Ruler (optional) -Labels or sticky notes

##Steps 1. Title Your Experiment -Write the experiment title at the top of the page. -Include the date and your name.

  1. Record purpose & Hypothesis -Clearly state the purpose of the experiment. -Write your hypothesis

  2. Document Methods -Record each step of your experiment. -Ne detailed enough so someone else could replicate it. 4.** Observation & Data** -Record all observations and measurements. -Use tables or drawings if needed.

5.Results & Conclusion -Summarize your results. -Note whether your hypothesis was supported.

6.Sign & Date -Sign and date your entries at the end.

##Tips -Always write in pen, never pencil. -Avoid leaving blank pages. -Be consistent with formatting and headings
